silent.title: The machine is not responding
silent.message: {{mudos}} of {{total}} points are returning no reading right now. When the VFD stops, it stops publishing speed, and without speed the module cannot compute RMS velocity: every vRMS is lost, while acceleration and peak survive because they are measured without knowing the running speed. What you see below does not describe a quiet machine: it describes a silent one.
